Name: farmhouse Interior Transfer
Author: yubinchui
Description:
Basically, the method involves pressing the save key (changeable in the config file! However, you must exit the game to make the changes...)Copying the interior, and then pressing the load key to load it.

However, since there is only one slot, you can only save one interior at a time.

Savings between farms (save files) can also be loaded!

Based on my testing, AT is not reflected, but furniture that adds CP works!

The furniture detailed adjustment mode doesn't seem to work well.... (It might not work at all...)

The default keys are:

Save Interior: F11

Load Interior: F10

You can change it using the config file.

The mod name is ATCPInteriorTransfer.
